sections.description:
CONSTITUTION OF THE
CONSTITUTION OF THE
ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF
PAKISTAN, ART.247
(Application of Laws in force
in Pakistan to the Federally
Administered Tribal Areas to
the extent of the universities
and its affiliated
colleges/institutions)
[Gazette of Pakistan
Extraordinary, Part II,
6th June, 2011]
S.R.O.
578(I)/2011, dated 2-6-2011.---In exercise of the powers conferred by clause
(3) of Article 247 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the
President is pleased to direct that the following laws, as in force in Pakistan
immediately before issuance of this notification, shall apply to the Federally
Administered Tribal Areas to the extent of the universities and its affiliated
colleges/institutions with immediate effect, namely:--
(a) the
Higher Education Commission Ordinance, 2002 (Ord. LIII of 2002);
(b) the
Federal Universities Ordinance, 2002 (Ord. CXX of 2002);
(c) the
Trusts Act, 1882 (Act II of 1882);
(d) the
Provident Funds Act, 1925 (Act XIX of 1925);
(e) the Auditor-General's
(Functions, Powers, Terms and Conditions of Service) Ordinance, 2001 (Ord.
XXIII of 2001); and
(f) the
Service Tribunals Act, 1973 (Act LXX of 1973).
